'''Kral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], who was engaged to a [[Unidentified Alliance medic|female medic]]. During a four-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] battle against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, Kral was wounded in the [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]]. Lying on a stretcher, he encountered his fiancée during a retreat; initially, she would not leave him until he pointed out that he could not walk, they could not spare the men to carry him, and that he had a painkiller with him to survive until the Empire picked him up. When the Imperial soldiers arrived, Kral used his painkiller; a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]. It was effective.
